intermediate.name: Alto de Españares
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Alto de Españares (28.2 km)

story: Stage 4 of the Vuelta a Andalucía Ruta Ciclista del Sol unfolded over a rolling route towards Pozoblanco. A small breakaway went clear shortly after the start and built a lead of a few minutes, but the peloton kept the gap under control throughout the afternoon. As the race entered the final 20 kilometres, sprint teams increased the pace, and the escapees were caught with around 8 km remaining. A brief late attack stretched the field but was neutralised before the flamme rouge. In the bunch sprint, Tom Crabbe proved fastest, while the overall leader finished safely in the main group.
